'''Esyram''' was an astronomical object located within the [[Esyram system/Legends|Esyram system]],<ref name="XWvTF" /> in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Battle of Esyram|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near Esyram during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
